dedupe_keys.name: gbs 20 7 ghz satellite attenuation measurements at dundee

description: The Chilbolton Facility for Atmospheric and Radio Research provides one-second satellite signal-attenuation measurements from the Dundee site in the United Kingdom. Receivers measured the 20.7 GHz beacon on the UFO-9 satellite for the Global Broadcast Service experiment. CEDA lists this station record from 2004-02-18 to 2006-08-30, within the broader August 2003 to August 2006 experiment. NetCDF variables describe attenuation relative to clear sky, receiver coordinates, antenna elevation, polarisation, satellite position and integration time. Access is free under the Open Government Licence version 3, with a registered CEDA account required for data retrieval. These observations can calibrate fade-duration and communication-link reliability simulations and validate the benefit of geographically separated receivers. They complement the other two GBS stations, not representing nationwide network coverage. The wider experiment dates must not replace the station-specific interval. Data retrieval, missing observations and instrument calibration were not independently checked.
